config.description: Inter-patient evaluation after de Chazal et al. (2004): the 4 paced records are excluded, DS1's 22 records are dealt to the 4 hospitals as training data and DS2's 22 records as held-out data (5 or 6 whole patients per hospital and side, re-dealt for each seed). No patient appears in two hospitals or on both sides of a split. Beats are segmented at the database's reference R-peak annotations (no detector), as in de Chazal et al., and shaped like the Kaggle export (see the beat check below). All beats are used; no subsampling. 20 rounds were fixed before the first run because one round processes ~100k beats (compute); this matches the Kaggle MIT-BIH experiments, while the simulated experiments use 30. No FedProx or DP in this setting.
config.title: 1e. Baselines, patient-wise: ECG, PhysioNet MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (DS1 / DS2)
